answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the meadow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, reset on any identity-link attempt, each submission carries a fresh nonce. The voyage holds work receipts rather than names, so the saffron of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
